decision: Prepare one native fixed31 paired correlation-by-radial-displacement experiment; no cutoff expansion, independent-arm optimization, fitted offset or automatic dispatch.

producer_endpoint_pair.context: StageB baseline/h0-plus; 1595 CI, 31 waves, original five signed UIDs
producer_endpoint_pair.scope: One pair arithmetic difference; not a transition-error bound or a producer/gradient repair

measured_scales.interpretation: The recorded correlation response is hundreds of cm^-1 and the nonstationary radial trajectory changes spectra substantially. The local micro-cm^-1 producer discrepancy warrants correctness qualification but cannot account for thousand-cm^-1 gaps. No measured current31 Breit/QED/recoil contribution is asserted; indicator is not an energy or spectrum error bound.

first_principles: At fixed common orbitals R, each model defines X_C(R)=E_upper,C(R)-E_lower,C(R). Correlation lowers variational absolute energies without forcing X_C toward experiment; measured accepted13 core energies demonstrate this.

Both the retained-space CI coefficients and radial orbitals respond to an excitation-class change. Therefore delta_corr(R) depends on R; its value cannot be transferred as an additive offset to another checkpoint.

Balanced treatment retains the same allowed excitation classes, Hamiltonian and common radial variation for lower and upper states. It does not require equal CSF counts, equal level shifts, or degeneracy-weighted orbital targets.
Nonzero full constrained EOL gradient is evidence of unresolved stationarity; failed residual/indicator gates do not identify a missing operator or supply a quantitative spectrum error bound.

experiment.hypothesis: The substantial frozen-orbital 5p two-hole response changes under common correlated radial relaxation; a paired finite difference can separate that interaction from ordinary baseline relaxation.
experiment.anchor: Literal accepted13 is used solely because the two model arms and failed complete-H diagnostic are already bound there; it is not selected by NIST. No rewind or replacement of terminal16 production trajectory.

arms.A: All91 original NR configurations / all1595 selected CSFs / five complete target symmetry sectors.
arms.B: The same91 plus the existing complete nine 5p4 three-particle NR rows / all100 configurations and2574 selected CSFs. No new radial keys, particle pool, deeper-hole class or correction.

experiment.direction: Use the full baseline-A correlated EOL gradient, its original constrained metric and original no-pair projector to form a complete preconditioned steepest direction. Preserve all same-kappa rotations, signed cross terms and native polar retraction; do not mask orbitals or reuse the measured large L-BFGS step12 direction.
experiment.step: Later source preparation must freeze one finite step from the physical tangent norm before trial-energy evaluation. Check signed descent and the original Armijo inequality in both arms. If either fails, retain the directional response but stop without admitting a relaxation update or searching other steps.
experiment.main_observable: For every upper-minus-common-lower line compute I = [X_B(Rdelta)-X_A(Rdelta)] - [X_B(R0)-X_A(R0)] = delta_relax_B - delta_relax_A. This is a measured correlation-by-relaxation interaction, not an extra correction.
experiment.also_save: All five absolute energies, signed complete CI mixing/actual norms, physical UID tracking, original metric residual and indicator at all four points; each four-line transition, D/P centroid and splitting; full source/model/snapshot identities.

distinguishing_outcomes.nonzero_resolved_interaction: A fixed-wave 5p correction cannot stand in for reoptimized balance; qualify finite-budget five-state MCDHF in the named model before adding classes.
distinguishing_outcomes.interaction_not_resolved: Report that conclusion only at the chosen finite displacement. It does not prove absence at a stationary point or justify removing configurations; first reach qualified baseline radial stationarity, then consider complete 4f double-hole or mixed-core classes at a common endpoint.
distinguishing_outcomes.tracking_or_identity_loss: Stop. A changed root or projector cannot be interpreted as differential correlation.

experiment.acceptance: Complete same-point native residual/Gram/owner/projector/signed UID gates, plus qualified directional derivative and the original actual energy comparison. Either sign of I and either movement of NIST gap is a valid diagnostic outcome; no experimental-improvement filter.
experiment.stop: One declared common displacement after qualification, no cutoff/seed/weight/step scan, no automatic retry or production checkpoint selection.

required_before_execution: Complete the root-owned same-pair forward/transpose discriminator. A pass there alone does not qualify an energy callback or restore the two original ordinary StageB finite-difference gates.

Any producer repair needs an explicitly frozen source epoch, matched complete-H/signed gradient/actual CI response controls and the original derivative criteria. Independently qualify the chosen common direction in both complete model arms; do not inherit the one-direction historical centered check as a general certificate.

Resolve or separately qualify the complete expanded-H source/representation, angular projection and live consumer call boundaries. The original core exact nested-byte FAIL and saved-diagnostic module-boundary FAIL remain archived FAIL; their small arithmetic bound is not a pass or permission to relax those gates.

Bind closed literal13 wave/state archive identities only in a reviewed execution contract; this record performs no NPZ access. Restore its exact projector/native metric and original531 signed tracker. The expanded arm has a new CSF objective identity even with the same five weights; do not silently resume baseline identity across it.

Predeclare raw2659 support, complete angular/gradient work, input decoding, memory/CPU/thread/wall caps and load gate before access/allocation. Existing8GiB H construction is a precedent, not a measured expanded-gradient peak or blanket admission.
Keep NIST validation-only, all experimental uncertainties unchanged/null where absent; use no Eu fitted scale and no imported FAC/GRASP/Breit/QED offset.

native_dependencies.future_production_continuation: Only after separate qualification, optimize_orbitals resumes actual terminal16 with unchanged baseline objective. Expanded objective changes require explicit new identity. The diagnostic performs no optimizer call.

work_before_science.reuse: Cache immutable complete angular structure per model; new immutable radial/H snapshot for every trial. Reuse same-point qualified CI only when owner and complete wave/source identity match; count qualification/archive overhead.
work_before_science.unmeasured: Expanded-gradient nnz/peak memory and controlled timings. No performance or AI speedup claim.

documentation_disposition: New owned decision record only. Root owns current-topic navigation and EARS integration; architecture/public capability interfaces remain unchanged. No new cross-task insight is promoted.
